name: 50263 · Waukee, IA
findings: ZIP 50263 (Waukee) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50263 (Waukee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50263 (Waukee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
